title: Ilyrium Provenance Record
description: Stage 8 ledger entry. One record per render attempt of one shot. Self-contained and reproducible: embeds the exact shot_spec, the generation parameters, model fingerprints, engine environment, output fingerprints, and HITL approval state. Lifecycle fields (status, approval, updated_at) mutate in place; the reproducibility-determining fields are frozen and summarised by content_hash.

record_id.description: ULID (Crockford base32, 26 chars). Monotonic, so it doubles as the ledger ordering key.

status.description: Lifecycle state of this render attempt.

attempt.description: Attempt number for this shot. Re-renders increment and set 'supersedes'.

supersedes.description: record_id of the prior attempt this one replaces, or null for the first attempt.

shot_spec.description: The exact Stage 2 shot-spec used, embedded verbatim for self-containment. Shape is defined by shot_spec.schema.json (sibling file).

shot_spec_hash.description: sha256 of canonical-JSON(shot_spec). See DESIGN doc for the canonicalisation rule.

steps.description: e.g. 4 for the lightx2v fast workflow.

keyframe.description: Stage 3 output image that seeded the i2v render. When the keyframe was produced autonomously by the t2i bridge (keyframe_to_comfy.py), the t2i_* fields record that generation's provenance. Older records that supplied the keyframe by hand omit them, so all t2i_* fields are optional.

t2i_prompt_id.description: ComfyUI /prompt id from the t2i keyframe render. Runtime handle; outside content_hash.

t2i_seed.description: Seed used for the t2i keyframe generation.

t2i_model_hash.description: sha256 of the t2i checkpoint/base model used to synthesise the keyframe.

ref_lora.description: lora_library.json entry name injected into the t2i graph, or null if none.

workflow_template.description: The Export (API) ComfyUI graph driven by shot_to_comfy.py.

models.description: Every weight file that materially affects the output, each fingerprinted.

render.description: Populated once the render runs. Null while queued.

comfy_prompt_id.description: The prompt id ComfyUI returns from /prompt at submit. A runtime handle, deliberately outside the content_hash domain.

approval.description: HITL gate decision. Null until a reviewer acts.

content_hash.description: Reproducibility fingerprint: sha256 of canonical-JSON({shot_spec, generation, models, engine}). Two records with the same content_hash should produce the same render. Excludes lifecycle fields by construction.

agent_version_id.description: RSI L0 (ILY-203): identity of the agent config version that drove this render — sha256(prompt.md + tools.yaml + routing.yaml + model id), computed by harness/config_hash.py. Inside the chained snapshot, so chain verification covers agent identity. Null on pre-harness legacy records.

chain.description: Append-only tamper-evidence. record_hash = sha256(prev_record_hash + snapshot_hash), where snapshot_hash = sha256(canonical(record without its 'chain' field)). Hashing the whole snapshot (not just content_hash) means the chain also attests status/approval, so tampering with any past line breaks the chain. Enables the 'ledger is hash-linked and append-only' invariant.

prev_record_hash.description: record_hash of the previous ledger entry, or null for the genesis entry.
